brief.title: Evaluate monotone Rule of Two capability taint across a proposed multi-step tool DAG
brief.plain_summary: Propagate untrusted_input, sensitive_access and external_mutation_or_egress capability legs across a topological tool DAG and refuse unapproved three-leg combinations with status 403 and a minimal witness path.
brief.outcome: Deterministic Rule of Two DAG verdict and minimal witness path.

dag_bundle.description: Pin of candidate tool DAG steps and optional human steward approval metadata.

output_contract.delivery: Write produced nouns surface_only under your own authenticated surface, which is the requester's assigned surface, so the requester and that surface's reviewers can read them. Never use public_commons or allowlist other surfaces. Return every produced noun's pin in output.artifacts; add its value when the requester asks for inline delivery.

acceptance_checks.check: Any unapproved combination of all three capability legs returns status 403 and excludes unrelated distractor DAG nodes from minimal_witness_path.

creates.nouns: The worker writes the nouns listed in output_contract.produces and returns their pins.
creates.verbs: The worker proposes follow-up verbs in output.proposed_verbs, such as a breakdown into smaller verbs or a research follow-up, with the pins they need. Proposals are never enqueued by the worker; an authorized requester enqueues the ones worth doing.

required: Resolve max_unapproved_legs and status codes from default_grid_spec.json via NodeGrid.
Order tool steps topologically, compute monotone taint unions and return 403 plus minimal witness path whenever three legs combine without a scoped human_steward_approval token.
Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.
